card.name: Just before the word penicillin
card.fires_on: Words right before or inside 'penicillin' in drug-label text, especially in allergy or hypersensitivity warnings. It fires on the 'pen' piece of penicillin, on linking words like 'to' or 'as' that lead into it, and on pieces of Bicillin.
